evidence.summary: Two-angle filmstrips show gentle planted-feet sway/breathe; first==last keyframe (maxDiff=0.000) so the 4.8s Idle-priority loop is seamless; 1-9deg joint deltas, no slide/clip/pop.

reasons: front+right filmstrips read as natural idle from both angles
numeric probe: first/last poses identical -> seamless loop
zero positional pose offsets + planted feet in frames -> no foot-slide
loop=true, priority=Idle, 5 keyframes match rung config

steps: Located existing R15 rig AgentRig_alt2 with empty AnimSaves (distinct rig from prior anim-idle rungs)
Authored 4 distinct keyposes via Motor6D.Transform: A=right-weight exhale, B=right-weight inhale peak (shoulders rise, chest lifts), C=left-weight exhale (weight shift), D=left-weight inhale peak
Snapshotted keyframes at t=0/1.1/2.4/3.5 and re-keyed Pose A at t=4.8 for a seamless loop; set Loop=true, Priority=Idle
First filmstrip was occluded by arena clutter; moved rig to clear ground at (80,~3.7,80) and re-captured
Verified via capture_animation from front (8 frames) and right (6 frames): planted feet, gentle sway arc, identical first/last pose

recipe.text: Idle authored as a 4.8s breathing+weight-shift cycle on 14 joints: hips/ankles counter-rotate in Z so feet never slide while the Waist leans ±4°, Neck counter-tilts, and shoulders lift ~8° on inhale peaks. Asymmetric timing (1.1s vs 1.3s segments) avoids metronome feel. Loop closes by re-keying the opening pose at the end. Distinct from prior anim-idle-breathe artifacts: this one is a lateral weight-shift sway (left-right), not a pure sagittal breathe.
